Fixes the correction-learning loop (introduced in v0.24.0) silently doing nothing in many apps. Watching the pasted-into field relied on Accessibility element identity, which browsers and Electron apps (Slack, Chrome, VS Code) report differently on every query — so the watcher concluded you had clicked away and gave up before you finished fixing the word. It now tracks the app itself, tolerates the transient Accessibility hiccups busy apps produce, and gets a second chance when the first observed change turns out to be the paste itself rather than your edit.

Every way the watcher can end now leaves a line in the app log, so if a correction still goes unnoticed, the log says exactly why.
